lines.zh: 缓慢地游动，发出微弱的嘶嘶声。
lines.en: Sloshes slowly, making a faint hiss.

lines.zh: 身体扭曲，试图靠近玩家。
lines.en: Body contorts, trying to get closer to the player.

lines.zh: 游动速度加快，发出尖锐的叫声。
lines.en: Swims faster, emitting a sharp scream.

lines.zh: 突然加速，试图咬住玩家。
lines.en: Suddenly speeds up, trying to bite the player.

lines.zh: 在水中蜿蜒前行，发出微弱的尖叫。
lines.en: Wriggles through water, emitting a faint scream.

lines.zh: 游动中发出微弱的咕噜声。
lines.en: Makes a faint gurgle while swimming.

lines.zh: 用嘴轻触地面，发出嘶嘶声。
lines.en: Taps the ground with its mouth, making a hiss.

lines.zh: 迅速游向玩家，发出威胁的叫声。
lines.en: Swims quickly towards the player, making a threatening sound.

lines.zh: 身体发出绿色光芒，显得更加危险。
lines.en: Body emits green light, looking more dangerous.
Body constantly contorts while swimming.

lines.zh: 鱼鳍反着长，划得歪歪扭扭。
lines.en: My fins bend backward and paddle crooked.
I ride the undercurrent along the cave roof.

lines.zh: 鳞片一片片翻起来，露出灰白。
lines.en: My scales peel back, showing pale flesh.

lines.zh: 我不需要水也能动一会儿。
lines.en: I can move a while without water.

lines.zh: 鳃边冒出不属于鱼的声。
lines.en: A voice not a fish's escapes my gills.

lines.zh: 我逆着水流，往你那边去。
lines.en: I swim upstream, toward you.

lines.zh: 静静地漂浮在水中，偶尔发出嘶嘶声。
lines.en: Floats quietly in water, occasionally making a hiss.
Stare emptily forward.

lines.zh: 身体逐渐扭曲，显得越来越不安。
lines.en: Body gradually contorts, becoming more restless.

lines.zh: 缓慢地摆动尾部，发出嘶嘶声。
lines.en: Slowly swishes tail, making a hiss.

lines.zh: 盯着玩家，眼睛散发绿光。
lines.en: Stare at the player, eyes glowing green.

lines.zh: 静静地漂浮，偶尔发出微弱的咕噜声。
lines.en: Floats quietly, occasionally making a faint gurgle.

lines.zh: 游动中发出轻微的嘶嘶声。
lines.en: Makes a faint hiss while swimming.
Body contorts, eyes hollow.

lines.zh: 慢慢游动，发出微弱的声音。
lines.en: Moves slowly, making a faint sound.

lines.zh: 漂浮不动，眼睛空洞地盯着玩家。
lines.en: Floats motionless, staring emptily at the player.
I hang in the water, tail stiff.

lines.zh: 有东西在我体内数着数。
lines.en: Something inside me is counting.
In an empty tank I still breathe.

lines.zh: 我的影子先动了，我才动。
lines.en: My shadow moves before I do.

lines.zh: 迅速转向玩家，发出嘶嘶声。
lines.en: Swiftly turns towards the player, making a hiss.
Stare at the player, body contorting.

lines.zh: 快速摆动身体，发出威胁声。
lines.en: Quickly thrashes body, making a threatening sound.

lines.zh: 眼睛盯住玩家，发出嘶嘶声。
lines.en: Stare at the player, making a hiss.

lines.zh: 游向玩家，发出尖锐的叫声。
lines.en: Swims towards the player, emitting a sharp scream.

lines.zh: 盯着玩家，发出嘶嘶嘶嘶的声音。
lines.en: Stare at the player, making a hiss-hiss-hiss sound.

lines.zh: 身体扭曲，试图靠近玩家
lines.en: Body contorts, trying to get closer to the player — Possessed Salmon, look player
Swiftly turns head, making a hiss.

lines.zh: 发出威胁性的嘶嘶声，盯着玩家。
lines.en: Makes a threatening hiss, staring at the player.

lines.zh: 我贴住玻璃，盯住你的手。
lines.en: I press the glass and watch your hands.
Pale body twists in pain
Scales fall off in agony
Haunted by evil, agony
Wounds bleed, weak
Haunted, endless pain
Struggling, pain
Haunted, pain
Possessed, agony
Pain like knives

lines.zh: 痛苦如影随形，无法逃避
lines.en: Pain follows, unescapable

lines.zh: 苍白光晕环绕鲑鱼，诱人至极。
lines.en: Pale glow surrounds the salmon, tempting anything nearby.

lines.zh: 被附身的鲑鱼游近玩家，目光空洞。
lines.en: The possessed salmon swims towards the player, its eyes hollow.

lines.zh: 附身鲑鱼张嘴，露出尖牙。
lines.en: The possessed salmon opens its mouth, revealing sharp teeth.

lines.zh: 玩家靠近时，鲑鱼突然加速。
lines.en: When the player approaches, the salmon suddenly speeds up.

lines.zh: 附身鲑鱼试图咬住任何东西。
lines.en: The possessed salmon tries to bite anything it can reach.

lines.zh: 苍白恶魔的呓语回荡在鲑鱼体内。
lines.en: The whispers of the pale demon echo within the salmon.

lines.zh: 玩家试图接近时，鲑鱼变得异常警觉。
lines.en: When the player approaches, the salmon becomes unnaturally alert.

lines.zh: 附身鲑鱼游向光源，不顾一切。
lines.en: The possessed salmon swims towards the light, regardless of danger.

lines.zh: 玩家喂食时，鲑鱼突然攻击。
lines.en: When the player tries to feed it, the salmon suddenly attacks.

lines.zh: 附身鲑鱼偶尔发出嘶嘶声。
lines.en: The possessed salmon occasionally hisses.

lines.zh: 附身鲑鱼与其他生物碰撞时，两者都会发光。
lines.en: When the possessed salmon collides with other creatures, both will glow.

lines.zh: 附身鲑鱼与玩家碰撞，玩家会受伤。
lines.en: When the possessed salmon collides with the player, the player gets hurt.

lines.zh: 附身鲑鱼游动时，碰到障碍物会发出咔嚓声。
lines.en: When the possessed salmon bumps into obstacles, it makes a cracking sound.

lines.zh: 附身鲑鱼与其他生物碰撞，后者会变得狂躁。
lines.en: When the possessed salmon collides with other creatures, they become狂躁.

lines.zh: 玩家被附身鲑鱼碰撞时会感到剧痛。
lines.en: When the player is hit by the possessed salmon, it feels intense pain.

lines.zh: 碰撞时，附身鲑鱼散发出幽绿色光芒。
lines.en: When colliding, the possessed salmon emits a greenish glow.

lines.zh: 附身鲑鱼游动时偶尔与其他生物碰撞。
lines.en: The possessed salmon occasionally collides with other creatures while swimming.

lines.zh: 玩家不慎触碰附身鲑鱼，会立刻感到不安。
lines.en: When the player accidentally touches the possessed salmon, it makes them feel uneasy.

lines.zh: 附身鲑鱼与其他生物碰撞时，两者会相互攻击。
lines.en: When the possessed salmon collides with other creatures, they will attack each other.

lines.zh: 附身鲑鱼在碰撞后会发出低沉的嘶鸣声。
lines.en: When the possessed salmon collides, it makes a low hissing sound.

lines.zh: 附身鲑鱼寻找同类时显得格外谨慎。
lines.en: The possessed salmon is extra cautious when looking for a mate.

lines.zh: 附身鲑鱼与同类相遇时，会尝试交流。
lines.en: When the possessed salmon meets another, it tries to communicate.

lines.zh: 附身鲑鱼与同类交配时，双方光芒四射。
lines.en: When the possessed salmon mates with another, both glow brightly.

lines.zh: 附身鲑鱼交配时，显得格外狂热。
lines.en: The possessed salmon is especially passionate when mating.

lines.zh: 附身鲑鱼寻找伴侣时会发出微弱叫声。
lines.en: The possessed salmon makes a weak sound when searching for a mate.

lines.zh: 附身鲑鱼交配后，会暂时失去行动能力。
lines.en: After mating, the possessed salmon temporarily loses its mobility.

lines.zh: 附身鲑鱼与同类交配后，双方会发光。
lines.en: After mating, both possessed salmon glow.

lines.zh: 附身鲑鱼交配时，双方会同步动作。
lines.en: When mating, the possessed salmon moves in sync.

lines.zh: 附身鲑鱼交配后会发出微弱的嘶嘶声。
lines.en: After mating, the possessed salmon makes a weak hissing sound.

lines.zh: 附身鲑鱼寻找伴侣时显得格外紧张。
lines.en: The possessed salmon is especially tense when searching for a mate.
Pale body, silver scales shine.
Prey near, eyes ablaze.
Eats carrion, stench of fish.
Swims to shadows, darkness hides.
Possessed, maniacal scream.
Target in sight, one strike kills.
Rotting scent, everywhere.
Deadly water, endless source.
Darkness, soul-devouring bait.
Corrupted spirit, consumes flesh.
Target locked, never rests.
Prey panics, chase tightens.
Fish scatter, I’m the king.
Dark currents, danger lurks.
Target ensnared, caught all.
Soul devoured, target dead.
Chase instinct, can’t resist.
Fish swim, I hunt alone.
Shadows, devour all.
Target falls, into the void.
Sibilant hiss, closing in.

lines.zh: 我在水里不动，等你涉水。
lines.en: I hold still in the water, waiting for you to wade in.
Fins sway, waiting for chance.
Water ripples, moving unseen.
Sibilant hiss, threat nears.
Fish scatter, I hunt alone.
Water ripples, chase starts.
Silent water, danger lurks.
Water trembles, one strike kills.
Soul-devouring bait, tempts prey.

lines.zh: 我逆流一甩尾，撞进你怀里。
lines.en: I whip my tail upstream and slam into your chest.

lines.zh: 我的牙咬住你的靴跟不放。
lines.en: My teeth clamp onto your boot heel and hold.
The current pushes me onto you.
I'm lunging up against the current!
Suck your blood, gurgle gurgle!
Taste the blood!

lines.zh: 逆流而上的鲑鱼，牙最利。
lines.en: A salmon swimming upstream has the sharpest teeth.
Gurgle gurgle, enjoy!
You won't live long!
Drain your life!
Pale demon appears!
Salmon variant!
A salmon upstream — but the wrong way.
Follow the demon's command!
Spawn in shadows!
Dive into deep water!
Attack nearby enemies!
Wait underwater for prey!
Demonic power guides!

lines.zh: 我从水底翻上来，鳞是苍白的。
lines.en: I roll up from the bottom, my scales pale.
Burned by fire
Fell into abyss, pain
Compressed by water
Explosion tears body
Pierced by arrow
Burned by magic
Starving, weak
Lightning strikes, tears body
Void agony, endless
